Quick technical/commercial notes for the sheet:
- If Acme stays on Hosted with a 1.5M tokens/month profile and a 70/30 gen/emb split, their average direct token cost delta (list -> 10% off) is ~ $1,080/month saved on tokens (not counting egress and cache effects).
- Prefix/KV cache: onboarding can quickly reduce steady-state spend for conversational workloads by 12–18% if we can cache consistent prompts. The onboarding credit should fund early caching engineering (placement of cache warmers, eval prompts).
- Dedicated vs Hosted: Dedicated unit economics become favorable above ~5M tokens/month, but require a minimum commitment and different SLAs. If they’re only piloting, avoid Dedicated pricing in the initial offer.
- Risk: a deep recurring discount with no minimum commitment creates churn risk if traffic dips; we typically protect with a minimum monthly commitment (MMC) or tiered true‑up.

I can draft simple language for an MMC and a rollback assistance clause (what we provide and what costs we cover).
